title: Count Good Nodes: Record Heights on a Cable Car Network
summary: Carry the highest station seen so far down each line; a station at least that high is a record, and counts add up on the way back.

analogy.scenario: Cable car lines branch out from a base station, and each number is a station's height in hundreds of meters. A station is a record if you're at least as high as every station you passed to reach it.

mapping.real: The highest station passed so far
mapping.abstract: The maximum on the path, passed down

mapping.real: Stations waiting for their branch's count

takeaway.summary: Pass the largest value on the path down to each node. A node at least that large is good. Each call returns its own 1 or 0 plus both children's counts.
whenToUse: A node's status depends on all of its ancestors
Counting or summing over a tree while carrying path state down

scenes.narration: Cable car lines branch out from a base station, and each number is a height. A station is a record if nothing you passed on the way was higher. How many records are there?
scenes.caption: Count stations at least as high as any before them

scenes.narration: You could ride back to the base for every station and compare it with each one on the way, but that repeats the same rides over and over.
scenes.caption: Rechecking every route from the base repeats the ride

scenes.narration: Instead, carry the highest height seen so far. The base station, 4, has nothing before it, so it's a record, and the highest is now 4.
scenes.caption: The base station counts: nothing came before it

scenes.narration: Ride left to station 2. You already passed a 4, so 2 isn't a record. The highest stays 4.
scenes.caption: Station 2 is lower than the 4 you passed: no record

scenes.narration: Station 5 is below a lower station, but it's higher than the 4 you carried down. That makes it a record.
scenes.caption: Station 5 beats the 4 you passed: a record

scenes.narration: Station 1 isn't a record either. Station 2 adds its own 0 to 1 from the left and 0 from the right, and reports 1 back to the base.
scenes.caption: Station 2's branch reports 0 + 1 + 0 = 1 record

scenes.narration: On the right, 6 and 8 are records and 3 isn't, so that branch reports 2. The base adds its own 1: four records in all.
scenes.caption: The base adds it all up: 1 + 1 + 2 = 4 records

scenes.narration: Stations are nodes, the height carried down is the path's maximum, and records are good nodes. Every node is visited once: O(n) time, O(h) space.
scenes.caption: Stations are nodes; records are good nodes
